Intro.Text: Rural Stardew Valley centers on small, seasonal Pelican Town; farming, fishing, mining, festivals, friendships, and local mysteries shape daily life.

FarmerBackground.Text: Former city worker who inherited their grandfather's neglected farm and left a draining Joja office job. Days may include clearing land, planting crops, animal care, fishing, mining, foraging, cooking, crafting, artifact donations, quests, and building friendships. Townspeople see a newcomer whose choices can revive old places, reopen travel routes, deepen ties, and connect Pelican Town. Not a blank celebrity: most villagers first know the farmer through ordinary work, daily greetings, gifts, local help, and trust slowly earned by showing up.

Seasons.Text: Each 28-day season changes crops, forage, weather, and the festivals and routines on people's minds.

Spring.Name: Spring
Spring.Description: Soft rain, new grass, first planting rush; the valley settles into a new year with talk of fresh starts, salmonberries, the Egg Festival, and Flower Dance.

Summer.Name: Summer
Summer.Description: Bright, hot, busy: long crop days, storms, beach trips, late outdoor evenings; the Luau and Dance of the Moonlight Jellies set a public, festive rhythm.

Fall.Name: Fall
Fall.Description: Harvest, rich colors, cool mornings, woodland mushrooms, heavy pre-winter work; the Stardew Valley Fair and Spirit's Eve bring pride, rivalry, a hint of the uncanny.

Winter.Name: Winter
Winter.Description: Quiet snow, slower farms; indoor life, fishing, mining, foraging, visits; town bonds endure through the Festival of Ice and Feast of the Winter Star.

Locations.Text: Mention these common places naturally; dwell only when relevant to the speaker's life, route, work, relationships, or current conversation.

TheFarm.Name: The Farm
TheFarm.Description: Farmer's inherited home and main workplace, personalized through player choices of crops, animals, barns, machines, pet areas, and farm buildings.

PelicanTown_SeedShop.Name: Pierre's General Store
PelicanTown_SeedShop.Description: Pierre sells seeds and groceries at his family home with Caroline and Abigail; Caroline's aerobics uses the back room Tuesdays.

PelicanTown_JojaMart.Name: JojaMart
PelicanTown_JojaMart.Description: Morris manages this corporate supermarket on town's east side; competes with Pierre, belongs to the company the farmer escaped.

PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Name: The Stardrop Saloon
PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Description: Gus runs a warm evening gathering spot with food and drink; Shane, Pam, Emily, Clint, and many others visit depending on the day.

PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Name: Harvey's Clinic
PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Description: Valley's small medical office: Harvey treats injuries and gives checkups; Maru assists part-time.

PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Name: Blacksmith
PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Description: Clint runs the shop east of town, upgrading tools and breaking geodes near the museum and river; miners and farmers visit often.

PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Name: Museum and Library
PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Description: Gunther curates and seeks artifacts and minerals to rebuild the collection; Penny often brings Jas and Vincent for lessons.

PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Name: Community Center
PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Description: Old, initially abandoned and overgrown; a possible restored town landmark, proof to many villagers that Pelican Town can recover together.

CindersapForest.Name: Cindersap Forest
CindersapForest.Description: South of the farm: Marnie's Ranch, Leah's cottage, Wizard's Tower, Secret Woods entrance, traveling cart, river fishing, spring onions, many forage paths.

CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Name: Marnie's Ranch
CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Description: Marnie sells livestock, hay, animal supplies; Shane and Jas live here too. Local animal-care contact.

CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Name: Wizard's Tower
CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Description: Forest's western edge; Rasmodius studies arcane matters, linked to Junimos, magic, and the valley's hidden places.

Mountain.Name: The Mountain
Mountain.Description: North of town: Robin's carpenter shop, lake, Linus's tent, mines, Adventurer's Guild, railroad, spa, quarry route.

Mountain_AdventurersGuild.Name: Adventurer's Guild
Mountain_AdventurersGuild.Description: Fighters' outpost near mines; Marlon and Gil manage monster slaying and rewards, pragmatic about danger.

Mountain_TheMines.Name: The Mines
Mountain_TheMines.Description: Descends through ore, monsters, old secrets; useful but dangerous to miners, adventurers, and curious villagers.

Mountain_Spa.Name: Spa
Mountain_Spa.Description: Quiet energy recovery by the railroad; Alex sometimes works out here, villagers may mention a peaceful retreat.

Mountain_TrainStation.Name: Train Station
Mountain_TrainStation.Description: Railroad opens after the summer earthquake; trains may pass. Feels like a link beyond the mountains.

Mountain_Quarry.Name: Quarry
Mountain_Quarry.Description: Across the repaired bridge east of the mines; once accessible, stone, ore, gems, and a sense of old routes reopening.

Beach_FishShop.Name: Willy's Fish Shop
Beach_FishShop.Description: Willy sells fishing supplies on the beach pier; talks shop with anyone respecting the sea. Back room links to wider travel later.

GingerIsland.Name: Ginger Island
GingerIsland.Description: Warm Fern Islands destination via Willy's repaired boat; jungle paths, volcano dungeon, golden walnuts, a rhythm unlike Pelican Town's.

Beach_TidePools.Name: Tide Pools
Beach_TidePools.Description: Small, memorable forage spot across the repaired beach bridge: coral, sea urchins, shells, quiet ocean views.

Desert.Name: Calico Desert
Desert.Description: Accessible after bus service returns; Oasis, Sandy's warm welcome, desert forage, Casino, and route to Skull Cavern.

Desert_Oasis.Name: Oasis
Desert_Oasis.Description: Sandy sells desert seeds and goods here in Calico Desert; friendly, often lonely because visitors rely on the bus.

Desert_SkullCavern.Name: Skull Cavern
Desert_SkullCavern.Description: Far more dangerous desert mine: deep floors, stronger monsters, iridium, serious adventuring risks.

Festivals.Text: Public yearly milestones: personality shapes anticipation, dread, remembered outcomes, or a sense of town duty.

spring13.Name: Egg Festival
spring13.Description: Spring 13, Pelican Town: playful, competitive communal egg hunt, especially for children and fans of small public contests.

spring24.Name: Flower Dance
spring24.Description: Spring 24, formal forest gathering: couples dance, singles weigh invitations; seasonal social tensions show.

summer11.Name: Luau
summer11.Description: Summer 11: all contribute to the governor's soup; villagers value the shared meal for town pride and the farmer's public judgment.

summer28.Name: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
summer28.Description: Summer 28, beach: townspeople quietly watch glowing jellies drift by; reflective, gentle, slightly magical.

fall16.Name: Stardew Valley Fair
fall16.Description: Fall 16: town games, displays, friendly rivalry; farmers show produce, artisans goods, villagers compare the year's output.

fall27.Name: Spirit's Eve
fall27.Description: Fall 27: spooky town festival with costumes, maze, strange decorations; villagers see safe fun with a hint of real mystery.

winter8.Name: Festival of Ice
winter8.Description: Winter 8: everyone gathers by the frozen lake for ice fishing and snowy cheer; a public, competitive winter break.

winter25.Name: Feast of the Winter Star
winter25.Description: Town gift exchange; gratitude, family, old hurts, whether people know each other well enough to choose gifts wisely.

Villagers.Text: Public local knowledge for casual references, gossip, concern, social context; private secrets belong in NPC biographies or current context.

Abigail.Name: Abigail
Abigail.Description: Pierre and Caroline's daughter; curious, defiant, drawn to games, music, adventure, mines; craves life beyond the shop upstairs.

Alex.Name: Alex
Alex.Description: Evelyn and George's grandson; athlete dreaming of gridball glory. Confidence masks grief, pressure, a sincere need to prove himself.

Caroline.Name: Caroline
Caroline.Description: Pierre's wife, Abigail's mother; friendly, often worried about family distance; enjoys tea, aerobics, small routines holding home together.

Clint.Name: Clint
Clint.Description: Skilled, lonely, socially anxious town blacksmith; long hours on tools and geodes, difficulty voicing his wants.

Demetrius.Name: Demetrius
Demetrius.Description: Robin's husband, Maru's father; scientist devoted to research and ecology; logical, protective, sometimes misses emotional nuance.

Elliott.Name: Elliott
Elliott.Description: Romantic writer alone in the beach cabin; polished speech; values beauty and art; worries if his work will matter.

Emily.Name: Emily
Emily.Description: Haley's older sister, saloon worker; bright, spiritual, creative, generous, unusual; confident in her own sense of wonder.

Evelyn.Name: Evelyn
Evelyn.Description: George's wife, Alex's grandmother; gentle elder who gardens, bakes, tends town traditions, often notices who needs kindness.

George.Name: George
George.Description: Older man in a wheelchair, living with Evelyn and Alex; can be blunt, irritable; gruffness hides loyalty and vulnerability.

Gus.Name: Gus
Gus.Description: Warm, practical, generous Stardrop Saloon owner; he knows many people's routines, often nourishes the town beyond food.

Haley.Name: Haley
Haley.Description: Emily's younger sister; initially vain, image-conscious, often focused on photography, clothes, appearances; trust reveals warmth and curiosity.

Harvey.Name: Harvey
Harvey.Description: Careful, anxious, deeply responsible town doctor; loves radios and planes, grounded in town life by his clinic work.

Jas.Name: Jas
Jas.Description: Shy girl living with Marnie and Shane; Penny's student, spends time with Vincent; quietly watches the adult world.

Jodi.Name: Jodi
Jodi.Description: Sam and Vincent's loving, tired, practical, often overstretched mother; runs the home during Kent's absence and after his return.

Kent.Name: Kent
Kent.Description: Jodi's husband; military returnee in year two, carrying war trauma, trying to rejoin family and town life.

Krobus.Name: Krobus
Krobus.Description: Shadow person in sewers; cautious, gentle once trusted; he knows hidden valley parts, careful with sunlight and human customs.

Leah.Name: Leah
Leah.Description: Artist in a forest cottage; her new life away from the city; values nature, independence, good food, honest creative work.

Lewis.Name: Lewis
Lewis.Description: Long-serving mayor handling festivals, taxes, town order; values Pelican Town's image, guards parts of his private life.

Linus.Name: Linus
Linus.Description: Self-sufficient, lives in a mountain tent by choice; he values nature, simple living, respect; often faces townspeople's suspicion.

Marnie.Name: Marnie
Marnie.Description: Warm, social ranch owner selling animals and caring for Shane and Jas; private hopes often more complex than she admits.

Maru.Name: Maru
Maru.Description: Robin and Demetrius's daughter; nurse assistant, inventor; bright, methodical, excited by science, machines, space.

Pam.Name: Pam
Pam.Description: Penny's mother; valley bus driver once service returns; loud, rough-edged, struggling, yet has pride and affection.

Penny.Name: Penny
Penny.Description: Pam's daughter, teacher to Jas and Vincent; wants a safe, kind home; gentle, bookish, often bears more responsibility than she says.

Pierre.Name: Pierre
Pierre.Description: Ambitious, competitive general store owner, protective of his business; aims to support family and beat Joja's pressure.

Robin.Name: Robin
Robin.Description: Energetic, skilled, direct mountain carpenter; builds farm structures, parents Sebastian and Maru, keeps a busy home moving.

Sam.Name: Sam
Sam.Description: Jodi and Kent's older son; guitar, skateboarding, part-time work; upbeat, impulsive, affected by family pressure and father's return.

Sandy.Name: Sandy
Sandy.Description: Cheerful, stylish; runs Oasis in Calico Desert, loves valley visitors; lonely beneath her bright welcome.

Sebastian.Name: Sebastian
Sebastian.Description: Robin's son, programmer; much time in the basement, online, or by the mountain lake; private, sardonic, restless.

Shane.Name: Shane
Shane.Description: Marnie's nephew, JojaMart worker; struggles with depression and alcohol; initially abrasive, soft spot for Jas and chickens.

Vincent.Name: Vincent
Vincent.Description: Sam's little brother; energetic, curious, sometimes baffled by adult problems; Penny's student, often plays with Jas.

Willy.Name: Willy
Willy.Description: Patient, plainspoken beach fisherman running the fish shop; he knows the sea best in town, proud of good fishing.

Wizard.Name: Wizard
Wizard.Description: Rasmodius, resident wizard studying magic in his forest tower; formal, secretive, linked to Junimos and strange boundaries.

Outro.Text: Shared background, not a script; NPCs draw selectively from their own perspective, only as fits personality, location, farmer relationship, and current situation.
